learning_outcomes.text: Name basic business administration terms and functions. Describe influencing criteria from company foundation, through company management to company development and reproduce the basics of personnel planning, management and motivation.
Deepen their knowledge beyond the discipline. Discuss company types and legal forms as well as company performance processes and carry out cost and revenue calculations.
Classify and evaluate strategic management tools and assess how location decisions are made.
Reflect on business administration aspects of engineering projects using case studies and possess the technical vocabulary to communicate with relevant specialists.

assessment_rules: The choice of examination type from the given options is up to the respective examiners. The choice of examination type will be communicated to the students at the beginning of the semester.
